press.line: Eating here feels like a meal at a friend’s home. Fresh dishes from Indonesian chefs.
Delicious Indonesian food, simple, with quick service and a relaxed room.

steps.text: Betawi opens in Dubai, made and owned by Indonesians.
We cook the way Indonesian homes and streets do: soto, rendang, sambal. Indonesian chefs cook each dish fresh, with herbs, spices and sauces from Indonesia.
Tables on the terrace by the lake in JLT, with the same cooking.
